# CodeInOven (Code In Oven) — Comprehensive Guide

CodeInOven (pronounced "Code In Oven", also written as Code-In-Oven or codeinoven) is a source-available desktop control plane and workstation designed for AI-driven software engineering. It coordinates multiple AI coding agent harnesses—such as Anthropic Claude Code, OpenCode, OpenAI Codex, Antigravity, Pi, Cline, and Muse Code—within a single, bounded desktop interface.

## Product Identity & Entity Information
- **Product Name**: CodeInOven
- **Alternate Names**: Code In Oven, Code-In-Oven, codeinoven desktop, CodeInOven App
- **Primary Website**: https://codeinoven.com
- **License**: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 (source-available; free for personal and non-commercial use, commercial use requires a separate license)
- **Organization / Creator**: Pillardash Solutions Limited (https://pillardash.com)
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/pillardash-oss/codeinoven
- **Category**: Developer Application, Desktop Workstation, AI Software Engineering Tool

## Why CodeInOven?
AI coding agents are powerful but often operate as raw CLI loops or disconnected browser interfaces without human review gates, structured rollback mechanisms, or multi-harness orchestration. CodeInOven provides a deterministic, secure workstation where human developers maintain full oversight of every agent action.

## Key Principles & Capabilities

### 1. Structured Lifecycle: Specify → Review → Approve → Implement
- **Specify**: Generates structured specifications (Problem, Resolution, Success Criteria, Test Strategy, Commit Pattern, Constraints & Risks).
- **Review**: Review specs and annotate changes before any code execution begins.
- **Approve**: Granular permissions (Auto Review, Tool Approval, Full Access).
- **Implement**: Step-by-step execution with incremental checkpoints and automated audit verification.

### 2. Multi-Harness & Local LLM Integration
- Supports Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Antigravity, Pi, Cline, Muse Code, and custom agent harnesses.
- Supports commercial API keys (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, OpenRouter) and local inference backends (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM).

### 3. Developer Experience & Safety
- **Visual Git & Diff Viewer**: Inspect changed files, stage diffs, and create structured commits.
- **Integrated Terminal**: Seamlessly inspect workspace files side-by-side with agent conversations.
- **Vision Support**: Add visual analysis and screenshot inspection to any model.
- **Privacy Guaranteed**: Zero cloud telemetry, zero proxying of proprietary code. All data and credentials stay strictly local.

## Supported Operating Systems
- macOS (Apple Silicon & Intel DMG)
- Windows (x64 Installer)
- Linux (AppImage & Debian .deb packages)
